paragraphs: Mari bar Rav Huna: this is the reading in Ein Yaakov and the Gemara, Eruvin 64a. It should read 'grandson of Rav Huna bar Yirmeyah bar Abba'; so too Berakhot 31a and in שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas], not corrected. Eruvin 21a: Rav Ḥisda said to Mari bar Rav Huna, son of Rav Yirmeyah bar Abba: 'You say you came from Barnish to Daniel's synagogue on Shabbat, three parasangs'—a place in Babylonia. 'On what did you rely? On huts? His father's father'—meaning R. Yirmeyah bar Abba—'said in Rav's name that there are no huts in Babylonia.' At the beginning of Tefillat HaShaḥar 26a, R. Mari bar Rav Huna, son of R. Yirmeyah bar Abba, said that R. Yoḥanan said. She'erit Yosef counted him among R. Yoḥanan's students. This requires examination, for his grandfather R. Yirmeyah was a student of Rav, R. Yoḥanan's colleague.
